vehicleBroom.name: Flying broom
vehicleBroom.desc: A flying broom. Ignores walls, water and cliffs, and needs no fuel.

vehicleCar.name: Car
vehicleCar.desc: A car. Fast on open ground, but it consumes fuel.

vehicleCamper.name: Camper
vehicleCamper.desc: A camper. Consumes fuel, and the party can sleep and store items inside.

vehicleBoat.name: Boat
vehicleBoat.desc: An inflatable boat. Costs nothing to run, but moves only on water.

vehicleBike.name: Bike
vehicleBike.desc: A bicycle. No fuel or upkeep, but it only travels on roads.

vehicleStarship.name: Starship
vehicleStarship.desc: A starship. Travels between planets and cannot be refuelled at road pumps.

originDeserter.name: Deserter
originDeserter.desc: Choose a faction you deserted. Start with 40 of its troops, hated by it and its parent faction.

originAugmented.name: Augmented
originAugmented.desc: Every party member starts with two or three augments already fitted.

originFactionLeader.name: Faction Leader
originFactionLeader.desc: Choose a faction. Start commanding 40 of its troops, in good standing with it and its parent faction, with two weeks of upkeep money.

originWarlord.name: Independent Warlord
originWarlord.desc: Start commanding 40 troops from random factions, with two weeks of upkeep money.

originCrash.name: Crash Landed
originCrash.desc: Start on a random planet in an uncharted galaxy with a damaged ship, almost no fuel and no jump charges.

originArtifact.name: Artifact Heir
originArtifact.desc: Start with one random ancient artifact.

originCeo.name: CEO
originCeo.desc: Start rich: €1,000,000 in cash and an 80% controlling stake in LimeCorp, at its headquarters.

originBunker.name: Bunker
originBunker.desc: Start in a stocked loot cellar under a random biome. Its gold is yours, and the hatch stays open permanently.

originStranded.name: Stranded
originStranded.desc: Start on foot at a random remote location.

originCriminal.name: Criminal
originCriminal.desc: Same start as the camper origin, but the party begins wanted with a 10,000€ bounty.

originMayor.name: Mayor
originMayor.desc: Pick a city, then begin there with 50 of every crafting material.

originDungeon.name: Dungeon entrance
originDungeon.desc: Start at the tower gate with extra potions, the tower routes map, a flashlight and a climbing rope.

originLot.name: Full automation
originLot.desc: Every party member starts with advanced crafting specializations, and the workshop starts fully stocked.

originBike.name: Start on bike
originBike.desc: Start in the countryside next to your bike.

originCar.name: Start in car
originCar.desc: Start in the countryside next to your car.

originCamper.name: Start in camper
originCamper.desc: Start in the countryside next to your camper.

originSpace.name: Start in space
originSpace.desc: Start in space, skipping the map selection.

originTrain.name: Start in train
originTrain.desc: Start on the train and pick your destination on the map (default).

rerollCharacter.name: Reroll character
rerollCharacter.desc: Randomize this character again and update the dossier.

ageElder.name: Elder (60+)
ageElder.desc: Old. Lived through the Psychic Wars.

randomTraits.name: Randomize traits
randomTraits.desc: Assign random traits to your character.

randomPersonality.name: Random
randomPersonality.desc: Assign a random personality to your character.

selectClass.name: Select a class
selectClass.desc: Choose your starting class from a list of archetypes.

randomizeAllParty.name: Randomize all party
randomizeAllParty.desc: Fill every party slot with a random character, then choose your origin.

totalRandom.name: Total Random
totalRandom.desc: Create a completely random character instantly.

newCharacter.name: Create New Character
newCharacter.desc: Create a brand new character from scratch.

hometownPick.name: Pick on map
hometownPick.desc: Choose your hometown from the map.

combatMonsters.name: Monsters
combatMonsters.desc: Capture monsters and fight with them. This cannot be changed later.

combatMap.name: Map Battle
combatMap.desc: Fights take place on the map instead of a separate battle screen. Movement is on the tile grid, weapons and skills have a range, and line of sight matters. Can be changed later in Options.

combatRpg.name: Classic RPG
combatRpg.desc: Standard turn-based combat. Skills cost MP or AP and are chosen from the command menu.

peaceful.name: Peaceful
peaceful.desc: Enemies never attack or chase you unless provoked, and you can Talk to them in battle. Defeat returns you to your last respawn point.

bloodAndOil.name: Blood and Oil
bloodAndOil.desc: Slashing hits can permanently remove body parts, with permanent stat penalties. Broken parts heal. Losing a vital organ kills the character instantly. Allies not revived by the end of battle die permanently.

permadeath.name: Permadeath
permadeath.desc: If your character dies in battle you must create a new one. Allies not revived by the end of battle die permanently.

roguelite.name: Roguelite
roguelite.desc: If defeated you respawn at the base floor of the dungeon. Fallen allies stay in the party and can be revived after battle.

originCardCollector.name: Card Collector
originCardCollector.desc: Start with a collection of monster cards and a ready-built deck.

originArcanist.name: Arcanist
originArcanist.desc: Every party member starts with four esoteric spells, school primers, a beginner's grimoire and robes. Choose your starting location.

originMercenary.name: Mercenary
originMercenary.desc: Every party member starts with a ranged weapon, plus a field vest, a medic's bag and survival gear for the party. Choose your starting location.

originLostConvoker.name: Lost Convoker
originLostConvoker.desc: Start at a random wilderness location. Every party member has eight summoning rites, a staff and a robe.

originSkeletonKey.name: Skeleton Key Holder
originSkeletonKey.desc: Start with only a skeleton key that opens any mundane lock. No other supplies. Choose your starting location.

originPlague.name: Plague Spreader
originPlague.desc: Start with a case of sealed vials containing the deadliest pathogens in the world.

originDiplomat.name: Diplomat
originDiplomat.desc: Start in Brussels with an ONU Terminal that gives remote access to the assembly. No other supplies.

originHypernetExplorer.name: Hypernet Explorer
originHypernetExplorer.desc: Start at the Hypernet Point with a bag of components and a half-built hyperdeck. The missing parts can be found in shops and houses.

3dRendersProceduralModelsSpritesUsesTheE: 3D renders procedural models, Sprites uses the enemy's character sprite.

statInfo.ARCANE: Arcane. How magical the character appears to others.
statInfo.SUBSTANCE: Substance. How stylish the character appears to others.
statInfo.STEALTH: Stealth. How well the character blends into the surroundings.
statInfo.INTIMIDATION: Intimidation. How threatening the character's gear appears.
